title: Let's Organize a Large Peaceful Protest in Mall World, and Demand Answers!
content: If we were to gather hundreds of lucid dreamers organized together at once, we'd basically create our own large pantheon of reality benders in the MallWorld. Even if you can't be very Lucid, just having a mass of any people there is good enough. It would a supernatural protest in our dreams for our right to exist how we choose, without other "we-know-better-than-you-because-we-have-more-power" beings forcing their ideals on humanity. It would be about not have our reality kept a mystery from us against our will! We might even find a way free ourselves from what ever evil veings hold us as their prisoners in this hellish world, if we protest there together! But make it peaceful, show them that we aren't lesser beings than them!
